title: Slice C findings: R-04's unchecked case and small café tooling gaps
item: Make R-04's checker and its unchecked list say the same thing, and fix three small tooling problems in the café folder that task 51 met
motivation: Found by task 51 (BDD slice C) and its review; these files existed before task 51's branch and it did not change them.
notes: Slice C's variant break-R-04-message was caught only by R-01 (variant_results.json). The advisor (tasks/advice/051-3.md) found R-04's checker skips a release with no answer during a change, while unchecked_sentences.json gives R-04 an empty list, meaning every sentence is checked. The reviewer (tasks/reviews/051-1.md, minor 1) found R-04's 'holds the changed table, and asks again' is reached in no scenario, because the reference agent raises there. Which of these is fixed, and how, is the owner's call; task 51's notes say fixing what slice C finds is the next task.
done_means: (1) judge_cases_b.json's _about no longer says its cases are not run, and names runs/judge-test-b.json. (2) uv run python generate_features.py --help prints its usage, exits 0 and changes no file. (3) probe/money.py's summary text names the ledger it summarizes, not task 56 by fixed text, and runs/task-056-money.json is unchanged. (4) In the café folder the whole test suite passes, generate_features.py --check exits 0 and variant_results.py --check exits 0.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-19 in task 51's merge, from the advisor's and reviewers' findings on earlier files (SKILL.md rule 2). On 2026-11-19 the manager drafted done_means, verified_by, may_edit and runs_as from task 51's results; the advisor ruled FAILS (tasks/advice/067-1.md) on the line about R-04's checker and unchecked list, whose either/or leaves the owner's choice to the builder, so only the four lines it held are kept. No line covers outside_problems 1 to 3 (R-04's checker, its unchecked list, the unreachable 'asks again'): which is fixed, and how, is the owner's.

outside_problems.problem: R-04's list is empty, which its _about says means its checker checks every sentence of R-04; the checker skips a release with no answer during a change (harness/checkers.py lines 194-195), and that case sits only under rows_not_checked for R-06.
R-04's checker skips a release with no answer during a change, so slice C's R-04 message variant is caught only by R-01.
The reference agent raises when a changed table is held (lines 56-57), so no scenario reaches R-04's 'holds the changed table, and asks again'.
It has no --help; given that flag it regenerates the feature files.
Its _about still says the cases are not run, though task 51 ran them (runs/judge-test-b.json).
summary() text is fixed to task 56, so a run on another ledger (task 51's) gets no money summary file.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS (advisor job d), tasks/advice/067-1.md: the line making R-04's checker and its unchecked entry agree fails, since its 'or the checker checks it' branch names no checkable behaviour and hands the owner's choice to the builder; the three tooling lines and the regression line hold. Kept those four.
decided_for_you.rejected: RULING: HOLDS with all five lines
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner picks one end state for R-04 (the entry names the case: then that line holds), or says what R-04's checker must flag at a release with no answer and whether a judge question is added; or wants the unreachable 'asks again' in this task.
